summary: The newly authored parity plan fully covers the implemented Writer-centric surface, separates justified browser adaptations from architectural divergence, and supplies dependency-ordered remediation and executable acceptance criteria.
findings: Evidence is concrete and internally consistent: material findings cite local modules and pinned LibreOffice owners; the plan explicitly identifies the unsupported 35/35 marker-based closure and makes inventory truth restoration the first work package.
evidence_refs: npm run check:dependencies && npm run check:source-tree && npm run check:source-provenance && npm run inventory:parity
residual_risks: The audit is static and plan-scoped; individual remediation packages must still validate their behavioral assumptions against executable upstream oracles before parity promotion.
